content.comment_body: I remember entering some text in the Online settings of my [product_name] PLC with [version_no]. When should this text show up? Currently, it doesn't display when I power on the device.
If the [product_name] operator panel loses power and then power is restored, you should see this message displayed for about 3 seconds.

Is this (power-on screen) only relevant for the [product_name] operator panel? Or does it also include the built-in display of the [product_name] PLC? I don’t see the message after restarting the power.

This applies only to the [product_name] operator panel. For the [product_name] PLC, it's possible to use a standard message text. You can activate it using the Initialization Flag and an off-delay, which gives the message text the highest priority.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unsure about when configured message texts are shown after power up on different display devices with [product_name] PLCs. There is some confusion over whether the power-on message feature seen on one operator panel is also supported by the built-in text display, creating a need for clearer information on message display behavior and setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the configured power-on message to be automatically shown on the integrated text display of the [product_name] PLC after a power cycle, just like it appears on the external operator panel.
